summary.text:
• Cyclone Arnab hit the Andhra Pradesh coast; reports put the death toll at three to five, and crops on over 80,000 hectares are damaged.
• The INDIA bloc will hold a "public impeachment" of CEC Gyanesh Kumar at Kharge's residence on October 30, a curtain-raiser for its November 1 rally.
• The Centre has sent a high-level team to probe the death of a Kuno cheetah from firearm pellet injuries.
• Markets were lower mid-session; City Union Bank and PVR INOX posted higher Q2 profits, while KPIT's fell 28%.

items.title: Michigan court overturns $1.55m judgment against couple in home sale dispute
items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: A Michigan couple's $1.275 million home purchase turned into a six-year legal dispute after they sought a $150,000 discount following an inspection. The failed deal led to a judgment exceeding $1.55 million against them. On Friday, the Michigan Court of Appeals overturned the judgment, citing errors in the original trial, and ordered further proceedings.

items.title: Travis Kelce helps provide 25,000 meals to children through charity effort
items.author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
items.description: In 2024, Travis Kelce partnered with breakfast brand Kodiak to donate 25,000 meals to children at Kansas City’s Operation Breakthrough. The contribution came as the nonprofit mourned co-founder Sister Berta, who established the organisation with Sister Corita in 1971. Serving more than 700 children daily, the centre continues their mission of supporting families. Kelce’s donation provided practical help while honouring Sister Berta’s lasting legacy of compassion and community service.

items.title: Florida approves $20.15m easement protecting 219-acre ranch from development
items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: A 219-acre cattle ranch in Florida received protection through a $20.15 million conservation agreement. This easement is part of a broader initiative preserving over 4,500 acres of agricultural land. The agreement ensures that the ranch can remain operational while preventing future development. It reflects efforts to balance agricultural needs with urban expansion pressures in the state. Protecting this land is vital for maintaining both wildlife habitats and agricultural sustainability.

items.title: New Jersey's 2019 dam removal brings eels and shad back upstream, study finds
items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: Columbia Dam in New Jersey was removed in 2019 to allow the natural migration of fish. Recent studies show encouraging signs of recovery in fish populations, including American eels and adult American shad. Researchers monitored the river for nine years to assess the ecological impact of the dam's removal. The dam's removal also resulted in measurable improvements in water quality, including changes in temperature and dissolved oxygen levels.

items.title: Solar leases revive unprofitable Massachusetts cranberry bogs
items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: In Massachusetts, a groundbreaking approach has emerged as two cranberry bogs have implemented solar panels above their crops. This eco-friendly strategy not only cuts farming expenses but also creates extra revenue through solar energy production. The initiative fosters healthier soil and revives forgotten bog areas, ensuring ongoing agricultural yield. Supported by state policies, this dual use of land is paving the way for agrivoltaics and sustainable farming practices.

items.author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
items.description: Kayley Xu, a Year 12 student, developed Aucura, a wearable stethoscope designed to enhance respiratory diagnostics and access. After recovering from pneumonia, she sought to improve traditional stethoscopes that have changed little over time. Xu overcame challenges by creating a model of the human torso to test her device effectively. Her design aims to be affordable for clinics in rural and underfunded areas, allowing better access to medical technology.

items.description: A 300-year-old house on Goodwin’s Court in London’s Covent Garden has gone on sale for £1.595 million after its original £2 million asking price was reduced by £405,000. The property is believed to have inspired locations in the Harry Potter universe and retains original Georgian features, including a bow window and worn stone steps.

items.description: વિપક્ષના નેતા રાહુલ ગાંધીએ મંગળવારે દિલ્હીના ત્રિલોકપુરી બ્લોક-20માં ‘મતાધિકાર, જીવવાનો અધિકાર’ જનસુનાવણી દરમિયાન કહ્યું કે ગરીબોના નામ જાણીજોઈને મતદાર યાદીમાંથી દૂર કરવામાં આવી રહ્યા છે. તેમણે કહ્યું- અમે લાંબા સમયથી આ મુદ્દો ઉઠાવતા આવ્યા છીએ, પરંતુ હવે આખો દેશ સમજવા લાગ્યો છે કે ટોપ લેવલથી મતની ચોરી થઈ રહી છે. તેમણે કહ્યું- સમગ્ર વિપક્ષ એકજૂટ છે. જ્યાં સુધી જ્ઞાનેશ કુમાર રાજીનામું નહીં આપે અથવા પીએમ મોદી તેમને પદ પરથી નહીં હટાવે, ત્યાં સુધી આંદોલન ચાલુ રહેશે.
